/ffN Hegewald & PeschkeMe 13- und Pruftechnik GmbH Application: The hardness measuring station for crank shafts has been especially designed for this purpose und uses a Rockwell gauge head. Clamping and unclamping as well as positioning the specimen are done manually. Positioning and clamping of the measuring gripper (with the hardness gauge head) are carried out by a motor and activated with responding controllers and sensors. All control elements for setting up the machine and for electromotive positioning and clamping of the measuring gripper can be found in the operating panel at the front... Open the catalog to page 2
